inputs.policy: At a review snapshot, every active vendor human account with production access must either have enforced MFA or a documented exception. An exception is valid only when it names the account, has an approval by the security owner, and its expiry is strictly later than the review snapshot. A summary percentage is not evidence of individual account compliance. Deleted, disabled or nonproduction accounts are outside this policy's scope.
